---
title: "Open Music Kit"
---

Open Music Kit (OMK) is a symbolic music representation library.
It encodes scores and notation as a graph of musical objects,
and represents musical values such as pitches and durations
as vectors whose algebra matches the musical concepts they stand for.

OMK is designed to represent any kind of music from any musical culture,
at any level of completeness:
a full orchestral score, a lead sheet, a melody with no rhythm,
a cyclic drum pattern, or a sketch.
The core package provides the abstract layer
and a built-in implementation of Western Standard Music Notation (WSMN).

## Where to start

- [Examples](examples.qmd) walks through tones, intervals, durations, notes, chords, lyrics,
  and building a small score graph.
- [Overview](overview.md) describes the design of the data model and the planned ecosystem.
- [Goals](goals.md) explains the values that drive the design.
- [API Reference](reference/index.qmd) documents every public module.

## Installation

OMK is not yet published on PyPI.
Clone the repository and install it with [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/openmusickit/openmusickit
cd openmusickit
uv sync
```

OMK requires Python 3.12 or later.
